title: spec: Add max slot claim duration to GCP-6.5 validation
description:
Add validation step to spec/08-gateway-coordination.md GCP-6.5:

After step 7 (expiry > now), add:
- Step 7a: expiry <= now + MAX_CLAIM_DURATION (default: 5 superframes, ~5 min)

Document rationale: short leases prevent squatting, force renewal which costs airtime.

Ref: project-LICHEN-worker6-70p7
close_reason: Added step 7a to GCP-6.5 validation: expiry - now <= MAX_CLAIM_DURATION (5 superframes = 305s with clock tolerance). Added Parameters table. Prevents slot squatting.
